protocol.privacy_scope: Use synthetic or specifically authorized text. Do not record private user keystrokes by default.

scenarios.procedure: Check known equivalent/distinct titles under the declared discovery policy; keep exact provider IDs and every collision.
Record actual IME updates/end/final input; assert complete final query and no stale publication.
Cancel or blur during composition; inspect actual field/caret state and request outcome.
Change query, route and field mount before results arrive; old callbacks cannot publish or steal focus.
Paste and use intended speech input; value comes from the control, not reconstructed key events.
Exercise supported dead keys and keyboard layouts without shortcut interference.
Replace selected text and use undo/redo through composition and asynchronous results.
Inspect truncation/highlights/caret around combining marks, emoji sequences and supported scripts.
Inspect mixed-direction labels with surrounding counts/punctuation and actionable source identity.
Activate controls using visible names; verify character shortcut off/remap/focus-only behavior.
Use declared screen reader/browser to inspect labels, changing status and preserved editing focus.
Compare installed runtime/data versions; rebuild derived indexes when policy/data changes without changing originals.

acceptance.note: Synthetic model tests do not establish browser, IME, accessible-input, Unicode conformance, search-quality or performance acceptance.
